chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
People are from various different trees, and I and you, Ali, are from one single tree.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the hadith describing people as different trees and the Prophet and Ali as one tree?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* employs the metaphor of trees to distinguish the general populace's diversity from the unified spiritual lineage of the Prophet and Imam Ali (AS). It underscores the concept of *Nubuwwa* and *Imamah* as a singular, cohesive entity, reinforcing the unique ontological status of the Ahl al-Bayt as the source of guidance. This imagery aligns with Shia theological emphasis on the indivisibility of prophetic authority and imamate.
